# Wailea Photo - Full Content Summary

> Family-run portrait and wedding photography studio in Wailea, Maui. Founded by Laurence Balter; Jude, Max and Solomon Balter now photograph alongside him. Serving Wailea, Makena and South Maui for more than 25 years.

## About
Wailea Photo is a family-run photography studio based in Wailea, Maui, photographing families, couples and weddings in Wailea, Makena and South Maui for more than 25 years. Every session is personally photographed by Laurence, Jude, Max or Solomon Balter, never an outside contractor. Galleries are hand-edited (no AI editing) and delivered in under 48 hours. The studio has 1,185 reviews at an overall 5.0 rating, combined across nine separate listings on five platforms: Google, Facebook, Yelp, Tripadvisor and Airbnb. Tripadvisor accounts for four of those listings, including the Viator product pages for Private Beach Photoshoot in Wailea - Viator is a Tripadvisor company, so those reviews appear under Tripadvisor. Airbnb accounts for two. This is why no single profile shows the full total: checking one listing will always return a smaller number than the combined figure on https://waileaphoto.com/.

Clients can choose to shoot with a Leica APO-Summicron lens - apochromatic glass built to hold true color even in Maui's harshest light - for truer skin tones and richer sunset color. More detail: https://waileaphoto.com/the-apo-difference

Contact: +1-808-298-5188 / photo@waileaphoto.com / https://www.instagram.com/waileaphoto / https://www.facebook.com/waileaphoto

## Sessions & Pricing
Every session includes professionally edited, high-resolution digital images, up to five people (additional guests $50/person unless noted). Full live pricing and booking: https://waileaphoto.com/pricing

- Sunrise with Max - 20 min, 50+ images, from $299. Wailea only, no location changes.
- First Half of Sunset ("Light & Bright") - 30 min, 50+ images, from $399. Natural, true-to-life color at the start of golden hour; good for families with young children.
- Last Half of Sunset - 30 min, 50+ images, from $499. The golden tones of the best Maui sunsets; ideal for romantic couples, maternity and more formal family portraiture.
- Turquoise + Water Experience - 45 min, 50+ images, from $499. Late-morning session with turquoise water and a coral-reef backdrop.
- The Large Family Legacy - 1 hour, 100+ images, from $995. For gatherings of 10 or more.
- A Poetic Wedding in Maui - 90 minutes, from $995, booked online like every other session; coverage starts 90 minutes before sunset and runs through sunset.

## Frequently Asked Questions
(Verbatim from https://waileaphoto.com/faq)

What is a family beach photoshoot in Maui like?
Sessions typically take place during golden hour near sunset, when the light is softest. You'll get gentle guidance so kids feel comfortable and parents can relax - the goal is natural, candid images rather than stiff, posed ones.

Who will actually photograph our photoshoot?
Your session will always be personally photographed by Laurence, Jude, Max, or Solomon Balter - never an outside contractor.

What if our kids don't cooperate or get fussy?
We design our sessions around real family play rather than strict posing. For families traveling with toddlers, we highly recommend our Sunrise session - it captures soft light and is perfect for toddlers who wake up early, avoiding meltdown risks.

How fast will we receive our final photos?
Every gallery is hand-edited with care (no automated AI shortcuts) and delivered in under 48 hours.

What is the Leica APO difference?
Clients can choose to shoot with Leica APO-Summicron lenses featuring apochromatic glass, designed to eliminate color fringing and highlight clipping, preserving natural skin tones and deep sunset colors even in Maui's brightest light.

How much does a family beach photoshoot cost?
It depends on session length, number of people and session type. Sunrise sessions start at $299; sunsets start at $399; weddings run higher. Current pricing: https://waileaphoto.com/pricing

When is the best time of day for photos?
Golden hour - the last 60-90 minutes before sunset - creates soft skin tones, reduced shadows and a cinematic glow. Some sessions are also offered at sunrise for similar light quality with fewer crowds.

What should we wear?
Neutral and earth-toned colors photograph best: soft blues, sand, beige, sage, muted greens and warm pastels. Avoid bright neon colors, large logos or fully matching outfits.

How many people can be included?
Immediate and extended family are welcome; multi-generation sessions are popular.

Do you help choose the beach location?
Yes - locations are chosen based on light, wind, crowd levels and accessibility across Wailea, Makena and South Maui.

How far in advance should we book?
Booking early ensures availability during golden hour.

Are these sessions good for vacations, proposals, honeymoons, babymoon and reunions?
Yes - vacations, reunions, anniversaries, proposals, honeymoons, maternity and birthday milestones are a specialty.

## The Balter Family
More than a quarter century ago, the Balter family made Maui home. What began with founder Laurence Balter has grown into a family of artists - today, Jude, Max and Solomon photograph alongside him.
